caption: The drawing depicts a wooden duck decoy placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The decoy has a detailed, rounded head colored in reddish-brown with a darker stripe extending from the beak through the eye area, which features a pale yellow iris with a dark pupil. The beak is dark gray with a hint of bluish tint at the tip. The body is plump, with a mix of muted brown, beige, and gray tones, and encrusted with small black specks. The wings are illustrated with a layered appearance, primarily brown with lighter, outlined feather details and a patch of iridescent green and white near the tail. The lower part of the body, visible below the wings, is tan with subtle shading. There is a signature "ROSE CAMPBELL-GERKE" written in small, neat, red-brown text below and to the right of the decoy.
title: Decoy Duck
